entries.en: to divide, split; to distribute, apportion (repartir)

entries.zh: 打票——开票、发票；领取／发给执照（sacar licencia）；签派、摊派（echar repartimiento）
entries.en: to get or issue a permit, to take out a license; to allot, to levy a repartimiento (colonial assignment of labor or goods)
entries.notes: M 栏交叉引页码 289/239 难辨；repartimiento 取 17 世纪马尼拉殖民地摊派（劳役或货额）义

entries.zh: 排门——挨户均分，按门分派给各家；平均分给众人
entries.en: to distribute equally, allotting door by door (household by household)
to pluck or pull off (arrancar); to peel, strip (pelar)
entries.notes: M 栏音写 fia/pia 两读难定，释义据 L（arrancar、pelar）与汉字“摘”互证

entries.zh: 勃——勃然，骤然（兴起、发作）；突然
entries.en: suddenly, all of a sudden; (of temper) to flare up on the moment
entries.notes: H 栏疑“勃/卒”难辨，M 音 pun 与“勃”常音有出入，释义据 L repentinamente 定

entries.zh: 临时——临事之际，仓促应付；权且、暂时
entries.en: on the moment, at short notice; for the occasion, temporarily

entries.zh: 豁然——倏忽之间，顿时开朗；一霎时
entries.en: suddenly, in one and the same instant; (of mind) suddenly opened clear
entries.notes: M 栏附加释语（presto mun scomy）残损难辨，主释义据 L/H/M 前段互证

entries.zh: 谬——反复絮说一事，重言不已；（字面兼）谬误、荒谬
entries.en: to repeat one thing over and over, to reiterate; (also, by the character) error, absurdity
entries.notes: R 栏例句污损难辨（T99），L 栏 casa/cosa 疑难定

entries.zh: 谬一过——重复一遍，再来一次；一遍又一遍
entries.en: to repeat once and again, time after time

entries.zh: 又一过——再来一遍，又是一次
entries.en: again, once more; time after time

entries.zh: 乱谬——语乱重复，胡乱重言
entries.en: to repeat confusedly, to say over in a jumble
entries.notes: L 栏西文释义残损（d'iparate damte 难辨），M 栏相应音写亦残，释义主要据汉字“乱谬”

entries.zh: 闹钟——鸣钟，敲响钟（钟声喧响）；指教堂鸣钟
entries.en: the bells are rung; to ring (peal) the bells
entries.notes: L 栏 Repican/Replican 疑难辨（于鸣钟义无碍）；取 17 世纪敲钟义，非现代“闹钟（时钟）”义
L 栏 los/las 疑（笔误级别），仍依纪律降为 medium

entries.zh: 古道——古拙谦和，安分沉静
entries.en: settled and humble; of simple, old-fashioned deportment, meek

entries.zh: 下午——午后，饭后歇息之时
entries.en: the afternoon; the resting time after the midday meal
